'''Swift''' is the horse owned by [[Galina Casban]].

==Appearance==
Swift is a gray mare with an arched neck and a lively step.

==Activities==
Despite being ''[[gai'shain]]'' to [[Sevanna]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]], Gailna is still allowed to ride Swift.{{ref/book|11|Prologue}} Swift was carrying Galina when she escaped from [[Malden]]. Galina and Swift were captured, however, when they stopped so that Galina could change her clothes.
